lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six visible vertical columns and five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a staggered grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming discernible grid-like anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 4-6 high-luminance spots visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant jagged notch or irregular indentation is visible on the posterior-ventral edge of the visible lower body/caudal region.
